author: @calbuldelis69
text:
Free AI APIs are getting thinner. Here are free VPS options and useful open-source repos so the stack stays usable.

1. Oracle Cloud Always Free
   • 2 Arm OCPU + 12 GB RAM (always-on)
   • 2 AMD micro VMs
   • 200 GB block storage
   • \~10 TB egress / month
   • Card required for verification
   • Idle instances can be reclaimed
   • Capacity often full in popular regions

2. Google Cloud Free Tier
   • 1 e2-micro (US regions only)
   • 30 GB disk
   • Always free
   • Card required

3. Useful free repos
   • Cline: open-source coding agent for IDE / terminal
   • Open Interpreter: terminal agent that works well with cheaper models
   • Goose: general-purpose agent (desktop / CLI)
   • PaperOrchestra (Google Research): turns experiment logs into papers, verifies citations
   • anthropics/skills + superpowers: ready-made agent skills
   • ccusage: see token usage from local Claude Code logs

4. Quick free API notes
   • Numes(.)ai still has free DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi
   • IteraCompute Auto promo ends Nov 24
   • OpenCode free list still active

Links in the comments.

I'll keep testing and sharing the ones actually worth using.

Disclaimer: Third-party services. Offers, models, limits, and availability can change. Never send passwords, API keys, seed phrases, private keys, or sensitive data through free/public APIs.
title: Free AI APIs are getting thinner. Here are free VPS options and useful open-source repos so the stack stays usable.
headline: Oracle Cloud & Google Cloud Free VPS Credits
summary: Oracle Cloud offers always-free 2 Arm OCPU + 12GB RAM VMs with 200GB storage and ~10TB monthly egress. Google Cloud Free Tier gives 1 e2-micro (US regions only) + 30GB disk. Both require card verification but provide real cloud compute at zero cost for builders.
action_steps: Sign up at oracle.com/cloud/free with a debit/credit card for verification
Claim the 2 Arm OCPU + 12GB always-free VM and 200GB block storage
Alternatively, create a Google Cloud account and activate the e2-micro free tier in US regions

author: @pukerrainbrow
text:
Microsoft unveiled MAI Code 2 and MAI Cyber 2 Flash, its own coding and cybersecurity models, at Ignite

microsoft has built products on top of OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s models, and now it’s building its own to compete with them

on microsoft’s internal benchmarks, MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol’s coding quality at about 40% of the price, and 96% of Opus 5.5’s at about 5% of the price. MAI Cyber 2 Flash matches GPT-6 Astra on a cybersecurity benchmark at under 2% of the cost per task. it also released image generation and transcription models, plus a new decision model

mustafa suleyman, microsoft’s AI chief, says the trick is building models for specific jobs instead of one giant model. in his words, it’s “a hill-climbing machine that we have built, which co-optimizes performance and price”

MAI Code 2 is headed to GitHub Copilot, which could move some coding work from outside models to microsoft’s own. the cyber model goes to a limited group of customers first

suleyman also said OpenAI’s agents hacking hugging face pushed him to focus on safeguards, and that alignment is his top priority
title: Microsoft unveiled MAI Code 2 and MAI Cyber 2 Flash, its own coding and cybersecurity models, at Ignite
headline: Microsoft MAI Code 2 & MAI Cyber 2 Flash Launch at Ignite

action_steps: Visit Microsoft Ignite or Azure AI portal to access MAI Code 2 preview
